# BuyAndBurn
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/BuyAndBurn.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IBuyAndBurn](../interfaces/i-buy-and-burn.md), ProtocolAccessManaged, [AuctionManagerBase](./auction-manager-base.md), ConfigurationManaged

**Title:**
BuyAndBurn

Implements a buy-and-burn mechanism using Dutch auctions

Inherits from IBuyAndBurn, ProtocolAccessManaged, AuctionManagerBase, and ConfigurationManaged


## State Variables
### summerToken
The $SUMR token that will be burned


```solidity
ERC20Burnable public immutable summerToken
```


### auctions
Mapping of auction IDs to their respective auction data


```solidity
mapping(uint256 auctionId => DutchAuctionLibrary.Auction auction) public auctions
```


### ongoingAuctions
Mapping of token addresses to their ongoing auction IDs (0 if no ongoing auction)


```solidity
mapping(address tokenAddress => uint256 auctionId) public ongoingAuctions
```


### auctionSummerRaised
Mapping of auction IDs to the amount of $SUMR tokens raised in that auction


```solidity
mapping(uint256 auctionId => uint256 amountRaised) public auctionSummerRaised
```


### tokenAuctionParameters
Mapping of custom auction parameters for each token


```solidity
mapping(address tokenAddress => BaseAuctionParameters) public tokenAuctionParameters
```


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the BuyAndBurn contract


```solidity
constructor(
    address _summer,
    address _accessManager,
    address _configurationManager
)
    ProtocolAccessManaged(_accessManager)
    ConfigurationManaged(_configurationManager);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_summer`|`address`|Address of the SUMMER token|
|`_accessManager`|`address`|Address of the access manager|
|`_configurationManager`|`address`|Address of the configuration manager|


```solidity
function finalizeAuction(uint256 auctionId) external override;
```


### setTokenAuctionParameters


```solidity
function setTokenAuctionParameters(address token, BaseAuctionParameters calldata parameters) external onlyGovernor;
```

### _settleAuction

Settles an auction by burning the raised SUMMER tokens and cleaning up state

Internal function called after an auction ends

**Notes:**
- effects: 
- Burns SUMMER tokens
- Clears ongoingAuctions mapping
- Deletes auctionSummerRaised entry

- emits: SummerBurned


```solidity
function _settleAuction(DutchAuctionLibrary.Auction memory auction) internal;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`auction`|`DutchAuctionLibrary.Auction`|The auction to settle|
